cohort: The study included term patients with spontaneous rupture of membranes (PROM) and clear leak at a Medical College and tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study found that 80% of patients with PROM had normal vaginal deliveries and fetal outcomes were generally favorable, with most not requiring resuscitation.
mod_finding: The study reported that 80% of patients with PROM had normal vaginal deliveries.
